title: List
description: Rows of like things: a face or an icon, a title, a whisper of meta, and somewhere to go.
usage: For indexes, member lists, file lists — anywhere the same row shape repeats. If rows need sorting or filtering, that is the Data Table pattern, not this part.
a11y: A real list element underneath. Rows that navigate are links; rows that act are buttons — never a clickable div.
